Guidance: Synthetic data for capstone R/Shiny development; not actual ERP records or evidence of German industry performance.
One purchase order line per row; 10,000 unique keys across four mutually exclusive sheets.
Order creation date; all predictors are snapshots known at cutoff. Dates stored as ISO text for stable CSV/R imports.
Train on Train; tune/calibrate on Validation; lock models and evaluate once on Test; score Scoring without target labels. Use temporal resampling within Train.
Deliberate gaps between partitions ensure preceding receipts are mature before next partition. Gaps are sampling design, not inactivity.

Do not use receipt_date, actual_lead_days, late_flag, order_status, dataset_split, future data or outcome-derived contemporaneous features as predictors. Exclude identifiers/audit and decision inputs from default core model.
Supplier histories use completed receipts strictly before order date, with synthetic prior smoothing. Records outside sampled windows are not generated.
1,000 open-order snapshots with all features and three outcome fields blank. They are a batch of historical-as-of examples, not a single live order book.

Inventory and demand are order-level snapshots, not a stock ledger; do not aggregate inventory across orders. Alternative supply and expedite inputs are quotes/assumptions, not measured intervention effects.
External_Signals contains simulated route-day values; join by signal_date and route_id. Supplier_Master joins by supplier_id.
20261115; stochastic assumptions, unequal supplier sizes, material and route differences, seasonal effects, shared shocks and unobserved errors.
Sources inform qualitative regimes only; rates and coefficients are assumptions, not fitted to German transaction data.
Use readxl::read_excel or CSV; enforce dictionary names/types, ISO dates, allowed categories, unique keys and same preprocessing/model version.
Simulate stockout units, service levels and costs under baseline vs intervention with identical demand scenarios; no observed causal benefit or recovery duration is supplied.
